title: Two parallel group pattern validation paths with no shared logic
description: Group pattern strings undergo two separate validation passes when loaded from config. First, validate_group_pattern in crates/transit/src/config.rs checks character set and consecutive dots. Second, WildmatPattern::parse in crates/core/src/wildmat.rs checks only for emptiness. These two validators are called in sequence (config.rs lines 579-585) but share no code. If the character set rules in validate_group_pattern change, WildmatPattern::parse is unaffected and vice versa. The right fix is to move character-set validation into WildmatPattern::parse so that GroupFilter::new is the single authoritative validator for pattern strings, and validate_group_pattern either disappears or becomes a thin wrapper.
